recentItems.title: Verity - Official 'Meeting Verity' Clip (2026) Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, Josh Hartnett
recentItems.description:
Check out the 'Meeting Verity' Clip for Verity, an upcoming psychological thriller distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Take a look at the first encounter between Anna and Verity in Verity, in theaters on October 2.

Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.

The film stars Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett. Verity is produced by Nick Antosca, Alex Hedlund, Stacey Sher, Michael Showalter, Jordana Mollick, Anne Hathaway, and Colleen Hoover.

Verity, directed by Michael Showalter, opens in theaters on October 2, 2026.

recentItems.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 - Official Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Graveyard Keeper 2 is available now on PC (Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store), PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. Watch the Graveyard Keeper 2 launch trailer for the cemetery sim sequel to see gameplay as you manage your graveyard, grow your zombie workforce, and more.

The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!

recentItems.title: Microsoft Hands Halo Over to Activision in Latest Xbox Shake-up - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Microsoft is continuing its great reset of its Xbox division with another massive shake-up. Halo will now be given to Activision, who will develop the next mainline game. Unfortunately that means layoffs for Halo Studios, along with a very likely studio closure for Ninja Theory. The Hellblade developer was set to be sold off, but those deals apparently had fallen through. And The Blood of Dawnwalker is getting a major update next month, and it might remove most—if not all—of the combat.

recentItems.title: Middle- Earth: Shadow Bundle - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer
recentItems.description:
Watch the Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer for Middle- earth: Shadow Bundle, a collection of both Middle- earth: Shadow of Mordor & Middle- earth: Shadow of War, two legendary open-world action games developed by Monolith Productions and Aspyr. Players will explore the era between The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings to uncover the mystery of a mysterious Spirit of Vengeance and confront the full power of the Dark Lord Sauron and his Ringwraiths. Both Middle- earth: Shadow of Mordor & Middle- earth: Shadow of War with the Middle- earth: Shadow Bundle are launching on September 30 for Nintendo Switch 2.

recentItems.title: The Beast - Official Trailer (2026) Samuel L. Jackson, Joel Kinnaman
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the Official Trailer for The Beast, an action thriller distributed by Aura Entertainment. Witness the full potential of The Beast in theaters on October 9.

When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the U.S., the president is forced to drive the presidential limousine and unlock the full extent of The Beast’s highly classified offensive capabilities to save his injured Secret Service agent, reunite with his wife, and save the world. 

The Beast stars Samuel L. Jackson, Joel Kinnaman, Guy Burnet, and more. The film is directed by Renny Harlin and written by Umair Aleem.

The Beast is in theaters on October 9.
